bad_request.title: Bad request
bad_request.detail: The request is invalid. Check the data and try again.

malformed_json.title: Malformed JSON
malformed_json.detail: The request body is not valid JSON.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.detail: The requested resource or route was not found.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not allowed
method_not_allowed.detail: This route does not support the requested method.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.detail: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

payload_too_large.title: Payload too large
payload_too_large.detail: The request body exceeds the allowed size.

unsupported_media_type.title: Unsupported media type
unsupported_media_type.detail: The request content type is not supported.

too_many_requests.title: Too many requests
too_many_requests.detail: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

error.title: Request failed
error.detail: The request could not be completed.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.detail: You do not have permission to perform this action.

invalid_credentials.title: Invalid credentials
invalid_credentials.detail: The email or password is incorrect.

account_locked.title: Account temporarily locked
account_locked.detail: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again later.

account_inactive.title: Account inactive
account_inactive.detail: This account is suspended or deactivated.

token_expired.title: Token expired
token_expired.detail: The access token has expired; refresh it.

session_revoked.title: Session revoked
session_revoked.detail: This session was revoked. Sign in again.

wrong_audience.title: Token not valid here
wrong_audience.detail: This token was issued for another part of the platform.

refresh_invalid.title: Invalid refresh token
refresh_invalid.detail: The refresh token is invalid or expired. Sign in again.

refresh_reused.title: Refresh token reused
refresh_reused.detail: A refresh token was used twice; the whole session was revoked. Sign in again.

scope_unavailable.title: Scope unavailable
scope_unavailable.detail: This account is not linked to an available factory or company.

otp_invalid.title: Invalid OTP
otp_invalid.detail: The code is incorrect; {remaining} attempts left.

otp_expired.title: OTP expired
otp_expired.detail: The code has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

otp_rate_limited.title: Too many OTP requests
otp_rate_limited.detail: Too many code requests. Wait {retryAfter} seconds.

identity_token_invalid.title: Identity token invalid
identity_token_invalid.detail: The sign-in provider token is invalid or expired.

identity_linked_elsewhere.title: Identity already linked
identity_linked_elsewhere.detail: This external account is already linked to another user.

invalid_client.title: Invalid client
invalid_client.detail: The client id or secret is wrong, or the client is not active.

failed.title: Validation failed
failed.detail: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.

key_required.title: Idempotency-Key required
key_required.detail: This request requires an Idempotency-Key header (uuid).

key_reused.title: Idempotency-Key reused
key_reused.detail: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

in_progress.title: Request in progress
in_progress.detail: The same request is still being processed. Please wait and retry.

stale.title: Stale data
stale.detail: The resource was changed by someone else. Reload the latest version and try again.

precondition_required.title: If-Match required
precondition_required.detail: This request requires an If-Match header from the latest version.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.detail: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

unexpected.title: Unexpected error
unexpected.detail: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again; contact support if it persists.

unavailable.title: Provider unavailable
unavailable.detail: An external provider did not respond. Try again later.

sod_conflict.title: Segregation-of-duties conflict
sod_conflict.detail: This action conflicts with a segregation-of-duties rule ({rule}).

role_escalation.title: Cannot grant beyond own access
role_escalation.detail: You cannot grant a role with permissions you do not hold.

self_grant.title: Cannot change own roles
self_grant.detail: Users cannot grant or revoke their own roles.

role_scope_mismatch.title: Role scope mismatch
role_scope_mismatch.detail: This role needs a {scopeType} scope and a user of the matching kind.

user_exists.title: User already exists
user_exists.detail: A user of this kind already has this e-mail.

not_replayable.title: Event not replayable
not_replayable.detail: Only failed or dead-lettered events can be replayed.

no_matching_step.title: No approval step matches
no_matching_step.detail: No approval step of the policy matches this request, so it cannot proceed.

already_pending.title: Approval already pending
already_pending.detail: This item already has a pending approval request.

not_pending.title: Request not pending
not_pending.detail: This approval request was already decided, withdrawn or expired.

not_authorised.title: Not an approver for this step
not_authorised.detail: You hold neither the role nor a delegation for the current step.

self_approval.title: Cannot approve own request
self_approval.detail: The requester cannot approve their own request, not even through a delegation.

already_acted.title: Already approved by you
already_acted.detail: One person approves at most one step of a request.

delegation_invalid.title: Invalid delegation
delegation_invalid.detail: The delegate must be another active staff member and the period must be valid.

not_owner.title: Not the owner of this setting
not_owner.detail: Only the {role} role may change this setting (D-063).

backdated.title: Cannot take effect in the past
backdated.detail: A new setting version must take effect now or later; history is never rewritten.

pending_exists.title: Change already pending
pending_exists.detail: This setting already has a change waiting for approval.

purpose_unavailable.title: Consent text not available
purpose_unavailable.detail: This purpose has no text in force yet, so consent cannot be recorded.

channel_unsupported.title: Channel not testable
channel_unsupported.detail: Test sends work for e-mail, SMS, LINE and web push to your own address only.

type_not_allowed.title: File type not allowed
type_not_allowed.detail: This file type is not accepted for {purpose} uploads.

too_large.title: File too large
too_large.detail: The file must not exceed {maxMb} MB.

upload_incomplete.title: Upload incomplete
upload_incomplete.detail: The uploaded object is missing or its size differs from the declared size.

not_ready.title: File not ready
not_ready.detail: The file is still uploading or being scanned. Try again later.

infected.title: File blocked
infected.detail: The file was found to be malicious and was removed.

code_taken.title: Code already in use
code_taken.detail: Another record already uses this code.

slug_taken.title: Slug already in use
slug_taken.detail: Another page already uses this slug.

calculator_required.title: No calculator yet
calculator_required.detail: A product type can be quoted instantly only once its calculator ships (D-100).

import_stale.title: Import changed since preview
import_stale.detail: The data to import no longer matches the preview you checked. Preview it again.

import_invalid.title: Import has errors
import_invalid.detail: Fix the rows with errors and preview the file again.

import_too_large.title: Import too large
import_too_large.detail: One file may hold at most {max} rows; split the file.

import_unreadable.title: Import file unreadable
import_unreadable.detail: The file must be an Excel workbook (.xlsx) in the exported template layout.

factory_exists.title: Factory already registered
factory_exists.detail: A factory with this tax id and branch already exists.

profile_locked.title: Profile locked
profile_locked.detail: Once the trial has started, legal data is changed only by the Packio Partner team.

invalid_transition.title: Invalid status change
invalid_transition.detail: A factory cannot move from {from} to {to}.

activation_needs_approval.title: Activation needs approval
activation_needs_approval.detail: Moving from trial to active needs the partner_activation approval (D-041).

site_visit_required.title: Site visit required
site_visit_required.detail: A passed site visit is required before activation (D-041).

nothing_to_sign_off.title: Nothing to sign off
nothing_to_sign_off.detail: This step was not entered by Packio staff on the factory's behalf.

bank_account_pending.title: Bank account change pending
bank_account_pending.detail: Wait for the pending bank-account change to be decided before proposing another.

bank_account_not_pending.title: Bank account not pending
bank_account_not_pending.detail: A verification call can be recorded only for a pending account.

agreement_not_published.title: Agreement not published
agreement_not_published.detail: This agreement has no published version in force.

agreement_already_accepted.title: Agreement already accepted
agreement_already_accepted.detail: The factory has already accepted this version.

backdated.title: Cannot take effect in the past
backdated.detail: A new version must take effect now or later; history is never rewritten (ADR-0005).

version_pending.title: Version pending
version_pending.detail: Wait for the pending version to be decided before proposing another.

not_capable.title: Factory not capable
not_capable.detail: Record the factory's capability for this product type first.

pricing_mode_missing.title: No pricing mode yet
pricing_mode_missing.detail: Set the factory's price-ownership mode before proposing prices (D-042).

wrong_pricing_mode.title: Not possible in this pricing mode
wrong_pricing_mode.detail: This factory works on a Packio rate card: it accepts or negotiates the card instead of proposing its own list (D-042).

no_price_list_tier.title: Tier holds no price list
no_price_list_tier.detail: Only tiers A and B hold price lists; tier C is quoted on request (D-043).

proposal_open.title: A proposal is already open
proposal_open.detail: This price list already has an open proposal; finish or withdraw it first.

proposal_closed.title: Proposal not in the right state
proposal_closed.detail: The proposal is no longer in a state that allows this; reload it.

proposal_empty.title: Proposal has no lines
proposal_empty.detail: Add at least one price line before submitting.

proposal_other_side.title: Proposal belongs to the other side
proposal_other_side.detail: Only the side that drafted a proposal edits, submits or withdraws it.

line_not_decidable.title: Line cannot be decided now
line_not_decidable.detail: This price line is already settled or is not waiting for your answer.

maker_checker.title: Maker cannot check
maker_checker.detail: Counters on a rate card are decided by someone other than its drafter.

version_not_awaiting.title: Version is not awaiting the factory
version_not_awaiting.detail: This version is not waiting for the factory's acceptance or sign-off.

price_line_conflict.title: Price line conflict
price_line_conflict.detail: A line no longer matches the version the proposal was based on; draft a new proposal.

vat_rate_missing.title: VAT rate not set
vat_rate_missing.detail: No standard VAT rate is in force for the pricing date; Finance must set it (accounting-design §2).

not_instant.title: Not quoted instantly
not_instant.detail: This product type is not quoted instantly yet; send a request for quote instead (D-100).

version_not_draft.title: Not a draft
version_not_draft.detail: Only a draft version can be changed; submitted and decided versions are frozen.

version_not_proposed.title: Not in approval
version_not_proposed.detail: Only a version waiting for approval can be withdrawn.

rates_empty.title: No rates
rates_empty.detail: Add at least one rate before submitting the version.

version_open.title: Version already open
version_open.detail: Finish, send or delete the open draft (or the version awaiting the factory) first.

version_not_awaiting.title: Not awaiting the factory
version_not_awaiting.detail: Only a version sent to the factory and not yet settled can be answered or withdrawn.

carrier_fixed.title: Not a fallback carrier
carrier_fixed.detail: The factory fleet is the default delivery method and cannot be changed here.

carrier_account_missing.title: No carrier account
carrier_account_missing.detail: Register Packio's own account with the carrier first.

series_missing.title: No numbering series
series_missing.detail: No numbering series exists yet for {docType}; a Finance Manager must create it first.

series_exists.title: Series exists
series_exists.detail: This entity already has a numbering series for the document type.

nothing_to_save.title: Nothing to save
nothing_to_save.detail: No quantity has an instant price; send a request for quote instead (D-100).

not_live.title: Quotation not valid
not_live.detail: The quotation has expired or was replaced; re-price it first (D-051).

still_valid.title: Price still locked
still_valid.detail: The quotation is still valid with its price locked; re-pricing is possible after expiry (D-051).

not_repriceable.title: Cannot re-price
not_repriceable.detail: Only an instant quotation that was saved, shared or expired can be re-priced.

closed.title: Request closed
closed.detail: The request for quote was accepted, declined or has expired.

invalid_transition.title: Not allowed now
invalid_transition.detail: The request for quote is not in a status that allows this.

quote_not_open.title: Quotation not open
quote_not_open.detail: Only a sent quotation within its validity can be accepted (D-051).

quote_not_draft.title: Not a draft
quote_not_draft.detail: Only a draft quotation can be sent or discarded.

quote_empty.title: No lines
quote_empty.detail: Add at least one quantity line before sending.

draft_open.title: Draft exists
draft_open.detail: Send or discard the open draft quotation first.

consultation_open.title: Already asked
consultation_open.detail: This factory already has an open request for this RFQ.

consultation_closed.title: Request closed
consultation_closed.detail: The request for a buy price was already answered or has expired.

item_exists.title: Already in the cart
item_exists.detail: This quotation option is already in the cart.

design_option_unavailable.title: Design option not available
design_option_unavailable.detail: Hired design needs a quotation priced with the design fee; free design needs a promotion.

mockup_price_unavailable.title: Mockup cannot be priced yet
mockup_price_unavailable.detail: The physical proof add-on cannot be priced yet; please contact customer service (D-072).

price_locked.title: Price still locked
price_locked.detail: The price of this item is still locked; no re-pricing needed (D-051).

reprice_unavailable.title: Cannot re-price
reprice_unavailable.detail: This quantity no longer has an instant price; remove the item and ask for a new quotation.

no_pending_reprice.title: Nothing to confirm
no_pending_reprice.detail: This item has no re-priced option waiting for confirmation.

cart_empty.title: Cart is empty
cart_empty.detail: Add a quotation to the cart before checking out.

price_expired.title: Price expired
price_expired.detail: Some items passed their price lock or wait for a confirmed re-price: {items} (D-051).

destinations_incomplete.title: Destinations incomplete
destinations_incomplete.detail: Each item's destinations must add up to its quantity.

shipping_unavailable.title: Shipping unavailable
shipping_unavailable.detail: There is no shipping price or delivery path for this address; please contact customer service (D-013).

rfq_destination_fixed.title: Destination fixed by the quotation
rfq_destination_fixed.detail: An RFQ quotation priced delivery to its own postcode only.

total_changed.title: Total changed
total_changed.detail: The total you saw ({expected}) differs from the current total ({actual}); please review.

wht_rate_missing.title: Withholding rate missing
wht_rate_missing.detail: The withholding rate {code} is not set; please contact customer service (D-174).

cancel_not_allowed.title: Cannot cancel
cancel_not_allowed.detail: Only unpaid orders can be cancelled here; please contact customer service.

reprice_has_discounts.title: Cannot re-price
reprice_has_discounts.detail: This order carries discounts; cancel it and order again.

reprice_below_paid.title: New total below the amount paid
reprice_below_paid.detail: The new total {total} is below what was already paid ({paid}); that needs a credit note (B5).

no_schedule_template.title: No payment schedule
no_schedule_template.detail: No payment schedule template applies to this order; please contact customer service (D-020).

schedule_has_payments.title: Schedule already paid
schedule_has_payments.detail: Something is already paid on this schedule; it cannot be replaced.
